title: EDB docs product registry definition (.registry.yaml)
description: Defines one product or section of the docs: the content directory it sits in. Checked when the docs are built and, through the yaml-language-server comment at the top of each file, as it's edited. What a schema can't say (a name used by two products, an icon that doesn't exist, a version directory the content lacks) is checked at build time.

icon.x-error: must be written <set>/<Symbol>, where <set> is default, color, logos, flags or edb_logos, e.g. default/Connect
icon.description: An icon of @enterprisedb/icons, as <set>/<Symbol>, e.g. default/Connect or logos/Postgresql.

nameRegistryId.x-error: must be a name-registry id (lowercase words joined by '-')

key.x-error: must be lowercase letters, digits, '-' and '_'
key.description: Nested products only, and only to resolve a collision: a top-level definition's key is its directory's name.

kind.description: A product has versions, a landing page placement and updates; a section is a group of pages that isn't one.

name.description: The full name, as it's introduced in the product's first paragraph.

aliases.description: Other `product:` and {{name(x)}} values that mean this product.

versions.description: `all` if every directory under the product is a version; a list if only those are (a hybrid); absent if the product has none.

hideVersion.description: Omit the version dropdown. Only for a product with exactly one version.

nameRegistry.description: The id of this product's entry in EnterpriseDB/name-registry.

type.description: The name-registry entry's kind. Written by the name-registry sync.

parents.description: The name-registry entry's part_of ids. Written by the name-registry sync.

alternateNames.description: The name-registry entry's legacy names and variants. Written by the name-registry sync.

ambiguousNames.description: Names of this product that also mean something else (a legacy product name that's now another product's cluster type). On another product's pages, one of these is read as this product only inside a link to its docs. The docs team's: the name-registry sync leaves it alone.

identifiers.description: The name-registry entry's current identifiers (commands, extensions, packages): a retired name followed by an identifier's type ("BDR extension") is that identifier. Written by the name-registry sync.

nameVersions.description: The name-registry entry's versions: only pages of a version one of these covers (by version prefix, so 6 covers 6.4.0 and 6.2 covers 6.2.1) are checked for this product's names, against that version's own name when it has one. Written by the name-registry sync; absent means not gated.

version.x-error: must be a version such as 6 or 6.2

homepage.description: Where the landing page lists this product: `false` for nowhere, or a placement. The link is derived from the product (its latest version, or its directory); `href` overrides it.

then.x-error: must be false (not listed) or a placement

group.description: The id of a group in homepage.yaml.

section.description: The id of a section of a wide group.

order.description: A sparse weight: entries of a group are sorted by it, then by label.

href.description: The route to link, where the product's own root isn't the target.

updates.description: "What's new" items about this product, written with the docs they announce. The landing page shows the newest three across all products.

date.description: YYYY-MM-DD: the date the update is ordered by.

url.description: Defaults to the product's own link.

then.x-error: homepage is required for a product: a placement ({group, order, ...}), or false to leave it off the landing page
must have exactly one version when hideVersion is set
